title: TWRP on Xiaomi 11T Pro Flash Recovery With One Fastboot Command
blurb: TWRP on the Xiaomi 11T Pro — one fastboot command boots the recovery, then you make it stick from inside TWRP itself.
video_description:
TWRP on the Xiaomi 11T Pro — one fastboot command boots the recovery, then you make it stick from inside TWRP itself.

Here's the trick most people miss. You don't flash the recovery image the usual way and hope. You boot it first with fastboot, let it come up, and then use TWRP's own option to install itself permanently onto the phone. That way you're doing the write from a working recovery, which is a lot less nerve-racking than a blind flash.

The whole job is: phone in fastboot, cable in, one command, then a couple of taps. No long wait, no drama.

🛠️ What You Need
• Xiaomi 11T Pro with an unlocked bootloader — TWRP can't go on a locked one
• A PC with the recovery image and platform-tools ready
• A working USB cable that actually carries data, not a charge-only one
• The image file for the 11T Pro — link below

📝 Steps
1. Reboot to fastboot.
2. Connect to the PC.
3. Type the command (fastboot boot file.img).
4. Wait until it boots into recovery.
5. Go to the Advanced option.
6. Select Flash current TWRP.

After step six it's on the phone for good, and a normal reboot lands you back in TWRP.

⚠️ Where People Get Stuck
• fastboot boot only boots the recovery for now. If you reboot the phone before step six, it's gone and you start over.
• Using a charge-only cable or a missing driver — the command just sits there waiting for a device.
• Locked bootloader. Nothing here works until it's unlocked.
• Taking an OTA update after this can put the stock recovery back, so keep the file handy.
